remarks: Welcome to the highly desirable Sylvan Knoll Section 2! This inviting two-bedroom townhouse offers a comfortable layout with plenty of potential to make it your own. The main level features a bright living room, dining area, and kitchen, while upstairs you'll find two spacious bedrooms, a full bath with a new exhaust fan, and convenient attic storage. The lower level provides versatile extra space perfect for a family room, home office, gym, or playroom. Recent updates include a new heating system, new copper piping for the washer and dryer, hardwood floors throughout the main and upper levels, and central air for year-round comfort. The basement has remained dry with no history of flooding or water intrusion.Enjoy a private patio, assigned parking, and the opportunity to garden in front of the unit. The monthly HOA of $533 includes property taxes, exterior maintenance, lawn care, and snow removal, offering exceptional value. The community is 100% owner-occupied, allows up to two pets, and is conveniently located just minutes from Cove Island Park, downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, and Metro-North.
